title: Hourly vs Fixed Moving Pricing in Addis Ababa
excerpt: When hourly moving quotes help in Addis—and when fixed prices protect you from gate delays, traffic, and open-ended standby charges.
content:
Two ways movers quote in Addis

Fixed-price quotes bundle crew, truck, and agreed scope after a survey. Hourly quotes charge by the clock—sometimes plus truck fee. Both are valid; the wrong choice shows up at condo gates when security delays the truck and the meter keeps running.

When fixed pricing fits best

  • Condo moves with elevator booking windows and possible standby.
  • Cross-town routes through Megenagna, Gotera, or Bole rush hour.
  • Office relocations with phased IT and furniture—scope is defined upfront.
  • First-time customers who want one number on paper before paying deposit.

Active Movers publishes starting tiers on the 2026 cost guide and homepage table; final fixed quotes follow inventory.

When hourly can work

  • Small loads—few items, ground floor, both ends easy parking.
  • Partial moves (furniture only) with clear start and stop tasks.
  • Internal office shifts within one building (desk reconfig).

Even then, cap hours in writing and define what happens if the job exceeds the cap.

Hourly red flags

  • No mention of minimum hours or crew size.
  • “We will see how long it takes” without truck or materials included.
  • Standby at the gate billed the same as active loading without prior notice.

Read our contract red flags guide before signing.

Hybrid quotes

Some jobs use fixed price for transport plus hourly packing—each line should be itemized. Ask whether fuel, blankets, and disassembly are inside the fixed portion.

Example scenarios

Fixed wins: Two-bedroom Friendship City move with a 3-hour lift slot and Gotera traffic between origin and Jemo destination—one number on paper beats an open hourly meter at the gate.

Hourly can work: Ground-floor furniture-only move within the same compound, both gates open, no elevator—cap at four hours in writing.

Traffic and standby clauses

Fixed quotes should state whether traffic delay is absorbed by the mover or triggers a change order. Hourly quotes should define whether security standby at the gate counts as active labor—see price creep prevention.

Office and villa tiers

Offices often mix fixed transport with hourly packing lines. Villas with long carries may use capped hourly for the carry segment only—each line itemized on the PDF.
